---
title: "Bad cell options (Jupyter)"
filters:
  - panzoom
jupyter: python3
expect-errors:
  - 'Field "desc-position" has value middle, which must instead be one of: `bottom`, `top`, `left`, `right`'
  - "ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:desc-position, in the cell starting `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt`."
  - "property name gruop is invalid"
  - "ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:gruop, in the cell starting `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt`."
  - "ℹ Did you mean group?"
  - 'Field "hint" has value maybe, which must instead be `true`, `false`, `show`, or `hide`'
  - "ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:hint, in the cell starting `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt`."
  - "property name gruop is invalid"
  - "ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:gruop, in the cell starting `plt.plot([3, 4])`."
  - "ℹ Did you mean group?"
---

Mistakes in `#| panzoom:` cell options, as Jupyter passes them (sorted by name),
also in a cell inside a `.panzoom` div.

```{python}
#| panzoom:
#|   gruop: a
#|   hint: maybe
#|   desc-position: middle

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.plot([1, 2])
```

::: {.panzoom}
```{python}
#| panzoom:
#|   gruop: b

plt.plot([3, 4])
```
:::
